# Multimodal Regression Fixtures

This folder stores deterministic fixture inputs for end-to-end multimodal regression tests.

- `fixture_manifest.json`: test plan and expected modalities for each input.
- `fixture_table_formula.md`: markdown sample containing table + formula signal.
- `fixture_notes.txt`: plain text sample for baseline graph/entity extraction.

The image sample is stored as base64 inline in `fixture_manifest.json` to keep fixtures text-only in git.
